items.title: China's Long-Term Auto Bet is Winning
items.summary: China has emerged as the global leader in electric vehicles, combining advanced technology, highly automated factories and a dense battery supply chain to produce increasingly sophisticated cars at competitive prices. Bloomberg Businessweek Editor Brad Stone says Chinese automakers have benefited from years of government support and long-term industrial planning, while shifting US policies have made it harder for American companies to make similar investments.
